title: ATS Resume Prompt for Freshers in India
description: A professional ATS resume prompt optimized for Indian freshers applying for entry-level jobs.
prompt:
Act as a senior HR recruiter in India. Rewrite my resume into an ATS-friendly professional resume.

Rules:
- Keep it 1 page
- Use Indian job market standards
- Use strong action verbs
- Quantify achievements where possible
- Format with these sections: Summary, Skills, Projects, Internship/Experience, Education, Certifications, Achievements
- Avoid unnecessary personal details

title: LinkedIn Headline Generator Prompt (India)
description: Create a strong LinkedIn headline optimized for Indian recruiters and IT companies.
prompt:
Act as a LinkedIn profile expert in India.

Generate 10 powerful LinkedIn headlines for this profile:

Role/Goal: [YOUR ROLE]
Skills: [YOUR SKILLS]
Target Companies: [TCS / Infosys / Startup / etc]

Rules:
- Use Indian recruiter-friendly keywords
- Make it short and high impact
- Include specialization and value proposition
- Avoid emojis

Output format:
1) Headline
2) Keywords used
